posts.title: The Impact of the Irish immigrants during the American Civil War!
posts.description: Many of the Irish immigrants arrived at the U.S. in vast numbers during the middle of the 1800s. There were many reasons for the Irish diaspora into America including the various famines in Ireland but also word regarding potential opportunities one could find on the other side of the ocean. posts.title: The 1926 Irish Census is now available online!
posts.description: Nationalarchives.ie home page highlighting the 1926 Irish Census As of this past April, the 1926 Irish Census is now available online through the National Archives of Ireland. According to the National Archives website, the Census of 1926 holds a unique place in Irish history since this was the first census conducted after the establishment of the Irish Free State.
